summary_en: GMO Financial Gate raised its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending September 2026 to 127 yen per share from 125 yen, following an upward revision of full-year consolidated earnings driven by stronger-than-expected initial sales in SME client acquisition and recurring revenue growth.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending September 2026
translation_en_brief:
GMO Financial Gate revised upward its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026. The annual dividend per share was increased from 125 yen to 127 yen, with the entire increase allocated to the year-end dividend.

The dividend increase follows an upward revision of full-year consolidated earnings. Net sales revenue forecast was raised to 22,000 million yen from 19,730 million yen, and operating profit forecast to 2,900 million yen from 2,800 million yen. The company cited strong performance in initial sales, particularly in the SME (small and medium-sized merchant) segment, where promotional initiatives drove accelerated merchant acquisition. Large transaction projects also progressed smoothly, contributing to the higher initial sales.

Recurring revenue also exceeded expectations. The growth in active IDs supported by strong initial sales, combined with larger-than-anticipated increases in settlement transaction volume and value, drove recurring revenue (comprising fixed fees, variable fees, and spreads) to expand faster than previously projected. The company's profit distribution policy also factored into the dividend increase decision.
